---
title: "Clustering"
---

![Clustering](week12_hierarchical_clustering_dendrogram.png)

## Interpretation

The dendrogram reveals clear groupings of tracks based on audio features.

## What this means

The playlist is not random, but structured around clusters of similar musical characteristics.

Different clusters represent variations in energy, danceability, and acousticness.

## Connection to the research question

Even within a diverse playlist, tracks group together based on measurable feature similarity.

## Key Insight

Similarity in the playlist is driven by **audio features rather than genre labels**.
